products.title: I Can't Explain quilt cushion
products.body_html:
• Inspired by Brighton's seafront architecture, these quilts from Jessica Ogden's Round 30 celebrate the aesthetic of Victorian tiling.

The result of a photographic collage, the quilt is composed of autonomous blocks assembled with deliberate freedom, creating a unique structure made up of visual discordances.
    To emphasise the cultural roots of this collection, each piece is named after a song by a famous Mod band.
  • Hand-assembled in India by specialised artisans.
  • Patchwork of fabrics in multiple colours.
  • Sewn onto a thin quilted backing.
  • Very limited edition.

products.title: Canada - Jean Touitou
products.body_html:
• In December 2022, Jean Touitou was inspired by a trip to his hometown of Tunis to create the mini EP "Canada".
  • The songs evoke memories of Jean's teenage years, including an imaginary place called Canada.
  • The first song, Canada, was arranged by Bryan Adams.
  • The Dub version is inspired by the Jamaican tradition of the 1970s, with the atmosphere of the streets of Tunisia.
  • The song "Ode au Cimetière du Borgel" recounts family memories of a cemetery, creating a mystical atmosphere with a twelve-string guitar.
  • Also available on all streaming platforms.
